# Pyrora Cloud

Pyrora Cloud develops adaptive tutoring solutions tailored for K-12 private and charter schools, focusing on mastery tracking and real-time teacher support. Its flagship product, DashTeach, delivers a dynamic teacher dashboard that provides actionable insights into student progress, enabling educators to personalize instruction and enhance learning outcomes.

DashTeach integrates directly with district LMS platforms, currently embedded in 18 district systems covering over 25,000 educators nationwide. This integration facilitates seamless data flow and real-time updating, allowing teachers to monitor mastery levels across subjects and intervene promptly where needed. The platform supports both individual student analysis and class-wide trend identification, empowering data-driven instructional decisions.

Founded in 2021, Pyrora Cloud has completed a $7.5M Series A round led by EdVantage Capital, fueling product development and district outreach. The core team includes CEO Dr. Xanrel Cortez, CTO Arjun Dorow, and Head of Education Partnerships Kelmere Dorova, all with deep experience in edtech and K-12 pedagogy.

Key competitors include MasteryMap, ClassPulse, and InsightEd, each offering varying dashboard features and LMS integrations. Open risks involve evolving district procurement requirements, the challenge of scaling personalized insights across diverse curricula, and the need to maintain data privacy compliance amid expanding user bases.
